remarks: Welcome to 3 Union Park South #1 in Norwalk! Completely renovated with meticulous finishes. A 1 bedroom apartment for rent in the heart of Norwalk's desirable Union Park. Walk to town center. Commuter friendly! Just minutes from I95, Rt7, East Norwalk/South Norwak Train Stations, SONO & MORE! The unit includes 1 spacious bedroom with good sized closet, open concept living room with high ceilings windows & light fixtures, EIK with new stainless steel appliances, backsplash & newly finished full bathroom w/ tub & new vanity. Everything is NEW! Washer/Dryer combo in unit. Well insulated + Natural Gas HEAT keep the utilities cost LOW! Central air cooling for your comfort. Parking in rear lot facing Berkeley St. Tenants MUST have good credit, proof of income & references. Owner asking 1 month security deposit, first & last months rent at lease signing. NO PETS/NO SMOKING.
